mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing clear skies and a comfortable 63 degrees, which feels like 62, over Reddan Soccer Park. Under tonight's first quarter moon, things are quiet, and there are no visible international space station passes expected.

The City of Verona is highlighting several sustainability initiatives. Residents can take advantage of the Solar Group Buy program through the Dane County Office of Energy to get lower solar rates, or grab rebates for installing rain barrels or energy efficient toilets. For apartment dwellers, food waste can be composted by dropping it off at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue.

We have some great local events lined up. Today, July 20th, features Yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Louie on Tuesday, July 21st. The highlight of the week is the Concerts in the Park on Thursday, July 23rd, at Century School Park, which is a fantastic free public concert series running all summer.

In police news, on Thursday, July 9th, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash with injuries at County Highway PB and American Way. A 16 year old girl failed to yield the right of way to a 74 year old woman, who sustained minor injuries and was transported to a local hospital.

The Culvers of Verona is currently closed and will open at 10:00 AM today. When they open, you can grab today's delicious Flavor of the Day, Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. If you can't make it today, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Caramel Twist.
